defect.description:
An accurate package length can be influenced by the following factors: - Raw material diameter, structure, surface condition - The temperature is - Process Parameters
Ensure precise article length: - Teach in length accuracy. - Increase the compression force. This ensures that no slip occurs when feeding. - Reduce acceleration and speed. Too high values lead to slip. - Enter the measured package length as a correction value. The correction value is calculated during production.

hintDescription.description: Correctly taught length accuracy leads to precise article, stripping and stripping lengths. - “Teach Length” on the Setup - Load Raw Material screen.

defect.description: Problems with cutting can be caused by the following factors: - Condition of the blades (wear) - Wrong cutting process parameters Ensure cutting: - Use flawless knives. - Adjust speed and acceleration. - Gradually increase the blade overlap. - Increase gripping opening on right; reduces the force on the blades.

hintDescription.description: Check the blades: - Reliable cutting requires flawless blades.

defect.description: Ensure a flat cutting surface: - Deactivate “Gripper opening right leading”. - Increase the compression force gradually.
Injuries to the raw material jacket have the following causes: - Blade opening too small. - Guides do not match the raw material.

hintDescription.description: Ensuring process-reliable processing of the raw material: - Mount guides that match the raw material. - Too small or too large guides can cause raw material jams and collisions with machine elements.

defect.text: Raw material jam in the machine
defect.description: If there is a jam of raw material in the machine, check all conductive elements: - Mount guides that match the raw material. - Too small or too large guides can cause raw material jams and collisions with machine elements. - The blade opening must not be too small.
